Maya (People Ops): Heads-up: we've pushed a micro-update to the handbook under Security -> Acceptable Use. New mandatory micro-training (12min) added; completion required by Jul 20. Link: https://intra.redwood.ai/handbook/security/acceptable-use

Jon (Security): This clarifies personal device policy + vendor laptop access. No immediate enforcement changes, just alignment across teams.

Carla (People Ops Manager): How is completion recorded? We need a manager view for audits.

Maya (People Ops): People Ops dashboard will show team completions; we'll provide CSV export. Also automated reminders go out to anyone not started at day 7 and day 2 before the deadline.

Riley (Eng): For contractors with weekly deliveries, will we count training as billable?

Maya (People Ops): Yes—training is counted as paid work for active contractors unless the contract explicitly excludes training. Contractors: check with your recruiter/vendor manager.

Riley (Eng): Can managers schedule a group session and mark completion for the team?

Maya (People Ops): We support facilitator-led sessions. Use the "Team Session" signup in Redwood Learn; facilitator marks attendees and we ingest that into the dashboard.

ContractorBot: Reminder scheduled: security-acceptable-use-due on 1771201820

Carla (People Ops Manager): Please share a one-slide summary and an FAQ for quick team standups.

Maya (People Ops): Will post slide + FAQ + short speaker notes in this thread by EOD tomorrow. Managers: flag any accommodation needs (timezone, accessibility) by Jul 10 and we'll arrange alternates.

Jon (Security): If any manager suspects a policy conflict with vendor agreements, escalate to security@redwood.ai before Jul 5.

Carla (People Ops Manager): ack confirm (I'll run the CSV export after the first reminder).
